description: The five LDA topic membership weights sum to one for each article.
rationale: The metadata defines LDA_00 through LDA_04 as a complete five-topic probability distribution, whose row-wise normalization is one.

    return 1.0 - (df['LDA_01'] + df['LDA_02'] + df['LDA_03'] + df['LDA_04'])

description: The positive and negative sentiment-word rates among sentiment-bearing words sum to one.
rationale: These two columns partition sentiment-bearing words into positive and negative categories, and the metadata states that their sum equals one after zero-sentiment rows are removed.

description: Absolute title subjectivity equals the absolute distance of title subjectivity from the neutral midpoint 0.5.
rationale: The processed feature is explicitly defined as the title subjectivity's distance from the neutral midpoint, rather than as its absolute value.

description: Absolute title sentiment polarity equals the magnitude of title sentiment polarity.
rationale: The processed magnitude feature is defined as the absolute value of the signed title sentiment-polarity score, discarding only its direction.
